description: This file contains a function 'getBidiKeyValue' that maps key names to their corresponding Unicode code points or characters, used for keyboard input handling in a browser automation context. It is part of the Playwright project, specifically related to the BiDi (Bi-Directional) protocol implementation for keyboard input.

methods.name: getBidiKeyValue
methods.description: Maps a key name string to its corresponding Unicode character or code point, handling special keys and returning their Unicode representations.
